close_reason: fixed: filter_properties now always includes id in email.rs
description: In handle_email_get (email.rs ~L448-456), when properties is Some([...]), effective_props is built from regular_props without forcing 'id' into the set. filter_properties then omits 'id' from every list entry. RFC 8620 §5.1 requires id to always be present. Trigger: Email/get with properties=["subject"] → response list objects have no 'id' field. Same bug exists in handle_email_parse (email.rs ~L1812-1820).
title: Email/get drops 'id' when properties list is specified
